title: Complexity Pairs Dataset: verified pairs of algorithms with different asymptotic cost
description:
An open, machine-readable dataset of complexity pairs: computational problems for which two or more correct algorithms of different asymptotic cost are recorded.

Every entry carries an explicit verification level that is enforced by the included validator. V1 means the implementations agree with each other on a test battery, and with an independent oracle where the harness defines one. V2 means the measured growth, from wall-clock time or exact operation counts, fits the claimed cost and rejects declared rival costs. Proofs of correctness and cost are part of an entry only where the entry gives them.

Results, refutations, corrections and null results are documented in a research log (RESEARCH_LOG.md), and recorded validation runs store every measured value (ledger/runs/). Data and documentation are licensed CC BY 4.0; code (validator, tools, search kernel, implementations) is licensed Apache-2.0.

Nearly all of the code, entries, analyses and documentation were written by an AI system (Claude, by Anthropic), partly through autonomous AI agents, under the direction of Benjamin Weisz, who is responsible for the content. Verification levels are checked by the included validator, unit tests and recorded runs; the README section "How this project is made" describes the roles.
